data.what_it_does: Provides liquid animation implementation from simple_animations 3.x. Allows configuring a Plasma widget using the liquid-studio website. There are no plans to add further features.
use_when: You need the liquid feature from simple_animations 3.x
You want to configure a Plasma widget using liquid-studio
avoid_when: You expect future feature additions or active maintenance
strengths: Provides specific liquid implementation from simple_animations 3.x
Integrates with liquid-studio website for configuration
weaknesses: There are no plans to add further features
